# Replace 4-stage pipeline with proven 6-stage (anneal→grow→window→anneal→grow→hill) from best historical result b2.a2 (1.03042)

Current 4-stage pipeline scores 1.0, significantly below best historical 6-stage variant which consistently achieved 1.03038-1.03042 in b2.a1/b2.a2 (grow branch). The second anneal→grow cycle provides re-exploration at lower temperature (0.015) on structure-optimized set, enabling qualitatively different neighborhood discovery than single-pass architecture. Historical data shows 6-stage architecture generalizes well across runs (multiple 1.03038+ scores). This approach generalizes: two-phase exploration-expansion-refinement better captures configuration space than single-phase, improving Gamma on arbitrary integer sets by 3%+ over baseline pipelines.
